comparison_note: 逐档人数、金额标签及已返回比例通过；零人数档允许省略，饼图由人数计算占比
sql: WITH deposit_balances AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(h.market_value_amount), 0) AS deposit_balance FROM dim_customer c LEFT JOIN fct_product_holding h ON h.customer_id = c.customer_id AND h.product_category_code = 'DEPOSIT' WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c.region_code = 'EAST' GROUP BY c.customer_id ), bucketed AS ( SELECT LEAST(FLOOR(deposit_balance / 1000000), 9) AS bucket_idx, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM deposit_balances WHERE deposit_balance >= 0 AND deposit_balance <= 10000000 GROUP BY bucket_idx ) SELECT bucket_idx, CASE bucket_idx WHEN 0 THEN '0-100万' WHEN 1 THEN '100万-200万' WHEN 2 THEN '200万-300万' WHEN 3 THEN '300万-400万' WHEN 4 THEN '400万-500万' WHEN 5 THEN '500万-600万' WHEN 6 THEN '600万-700万' WHEN 7 THEN '700万-800万' WHEN 8 THEN '800万-900万' WHEN 9 THEN '900万-1000万' END AS deposit_band, customer_count, ROUND(customer_count * 100.0 / SUM(customer_count) OVER (), 2) AS customer_ratio_pct FROM bucketed ORDER BY bucket_idx LIMIT 100

comparison_note: 逐档人数、金额标签及已返回比例通过；零人数档允许省略，饼图由人数计算占比
sql: WITH deposit_balance AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(h.market_value_amount), 0) AS deposit_amount FROM dim_customer c LEFT JOIN fct_product_holding h ON h.customer_id = c.customer_id AND h.product_category_code = 'DEPOSIT' AND h.snapshot_date = '2026-08-28' WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c.manager_id = 'M0001' GROUP BY c.customer_id ) SELECT band_no, CONCAT(band_no * 50, '-', (band_no + 1) * 50, '万') AS deposit_band_label, customer_count, customer_count * 100.0 / total_count AS customer_ratio FROM ( SELECT LEAST(FLOOR(db.deposit_amount / 500000), 11) AS band_no, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_count FROM deposit_balance db WHERE db.deposit_amount BETWEEN 0 AND 6000000 GROUP BY LEAST(FLOOR(db.deposit_amount / 500000), 11) ) t ORDER BY band_no LIMIT 100

comparison_note: 逐性别比较人数，支持常用中文标签
sql: SELECT gender_code, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() AS customer_ratio FROM dim_customer c WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c.region_code = 'EAST' GROUP BY gender_code ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 100
